summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper implementing the W3C CBD rules 1 and 2 (reification via rdf:subject, typed or untyped). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rule counts, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank node in reification not expanded, blank-node cycle termination, and source immutability. Tests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were verified by hand only. No commits made, no docs page added, no imports added.
